The staff who helped us were amazing!
Oct 2025 • Couples
Firstly let me say that TRAN (server) and
HUNG (bar) were superb server/barman-mixologist. They were absolutely perfect with excellent customer service, & deserve praise from this lovely hotel. Please ensure that Hung & Tran are told how much we appreciated their superb service.
This bar is delightful. Awesome views, amazing cocktails, delicious food. We are here in the rainy season so stayed inside, but outside looked glorious. Highly recommended.
If we can suggest one tiny change, the music is way too loud and not required for the crowd in the bar. The first night we went up there was a DJ and very loud music - we couldn't even have a conversation! The second time we asked for the music to please be turned down & then it was wonderful with just background ambience and a superb atmosphere. Advice to hotel: read the room. You might lose more customers than you gain with the loud repetitive DJ beats! Some people just want a peaceful & stylish experience. 

I know De Nang is a party town but there are plenty of places to go for a noisy night out - keep it classy IHG, go for rooftop serenity with the occasional noisy night!
Read more
Written October 19, 2025
Voco M
Dear Mr. Nicky,

Thank you for your fantastic review of Ciela Skybar & Dining! We're happy you had such a delightful experience and highly recommend us, noting the awesome views, amazing cocktails, and delicious food.

We are proud to hear your high praise for Tran and Hung. They are valued members of our team, and we will absolutely ensure they are recognized and commended for their superb service and excellent customer service.

We also appreciate you sharing your candid feedback regarding the music volume, especially during your first visit. We appreciate you letting us know that the atmosphere was wonderful once the music was adjusted to a background level.

Thank you for your advice to "read the room". We are reviewing our music volume levels to ensure we maintain the classy and rooftop serenity that our guests expect, reserving the higher-energy music for designated times.

We hope to welcome you back soon!

Warm regards,

Thien Khoa
